name: Mechanical sludge dewatering
applications: digested or raw sludge dewatering at every plant
principle: Standard published practice: conditioned sludge (polymer dosed) is dewatered by decanter centrifuges (2,500-4,000 rpm bowl), belt filter presses (gravity drain + wedge press) or membrane/plate filter presses (batch 12-16 bar); cake dryness 18-35% DS depending on device and sludge type; licensor equipment from Alfa Laval, Andritz, Flottweg, HUBER (screw presses).

process_steps.name: Mechanical dewatering
equipment: decanter centrifuge / belt press / membrane filter press

performance.metric: cake dry solids, centrifuge on digested sludge
cake dry solids, membrane filter press

costs.metric: capital cost, belt filter press (0.5 m belt, about 500 dry lb/h)
costs.basis: Vendor estimates in EPA 832-F-00-057: USD 47,500 for a 0.5 m belt (about 500 dry pounds per hour) on 5 percent solids feed. Excludes installation, shipping and ancillary equipment such as flow control and centrate management. Document year recorded; no dollar year stated.

source.note: US EPA, Biosolids Technology Fact Sheet: Belt Filter Press, EPA 832-F-00-057, September 2000, COSTS section (vendor estimates)

costs.metric: capital cost, belt filter press (1.5 m belt, about 1,625 dry lb/h)
costs.basis: Same sheet: USD 115,000 for a 1.5 m belt (about 1,625 dry pounds per hour), 5 percent solids feed, excluding installation, shipping and ancillary equipment.

source.note: US EPA, Biosolids Technology Fact Sheet: Belt Filter Press, EPA 832-F-00-057, September 2000, COSTS section (vendor estimates)

costs.metric: operation and maintenance cost, belt filter press
costs.unit: USD per dry ton of solids
costs.basis: Overall operation and maintenance costs range from USD 80 to USD 200 per dry ton of solids. Polymer conditioning adds USD 2.65-91.15 per million gallons (average USD 24.38), and permanganate about USD 1 per million gallons.

source.note: US EPA, Biosolids Technology Fact Sheet: Belt Filter Press, EPA 832-F-00-057, September 2000, COSTS section (vendor estimates)
